note: Tests the starting build of round 4 fails, why, the item of REVIEW-v0.5.md, and the step that fixes it. Measured on v0.5 (build R4F2) on 22 Nov 2026. The three entries fixed by round 3 turn into XPASS once round 3 lands: remove them then. A step removes its entries when its tests pass under --must; a finished round passes --strict.
